description: This file implements logging functionalities for the SAP namespace, including initialization, logging with different levels, and environment-based configurations. It supports conditional compilation for RDK logger integration and provides timestamped, formatted log output.

methods.name: sync_stdout
methods.description: Configures stdout buffering if the environment variable 'SYNC_STDOUT' is set.

methods.name: methodName
methods.description: Extracts the method name from a pretty function string.

methods.name: logger_init
methods.description: Initializes the logger, setting up stdout sync and environment-based log level or RDK logger.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with specified level, function, file, line, and format, either using RDK logger or standard output depending on compilation flags.
